build_rmsnorm_layer: build an RMSNorm layer for root mean square normalization with configurable hidden size and epsilon
build_layernorm_layer: build a LayerNorm layer with configurable hidden size, bias, and elementwise affine options
apply_qk_norm: apply QK normalization to query and key tensors with fused CUDA fast path support
apply_qk_norm_rope: apply QK normalization followed by RoPE positional encoding on query and key tensors
apply_rmsnorm_tanh_mul_add: compute residual plus tanh-gated RMS normalized output with fused CUDA fast path
